CheckTitle: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to port 22
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks whether security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to TCP port 22 (SSH).
Risk: SSH is a remote administration protocol. Exposure to the whole internet invites brute-force, credential-stuffing and exploit attempts.

Recommendation.Text: Restrict ingress to TCP port 22 (SSH) to known administrative CIDRs, or use SSM Session Manager / a bastion instead of direct exposure.
